arxiv-2006-15138.description: Abstract In a cell-free network, a large number of mobile devices are served simultaneously by several base stations (BSs)/access points(APs) using the same time/frequency resources. However, this creates high signal processing demands (e.g. for beamforming) at the transmitters and receivers.

arxiv-2510-08684.title: A Vertically Orientated Dark Matter Halo Marks a Flip of the Galactic Disk
arxiv-2510-08684.creator: Ling Zhu 1, Runsheng Cai 1, Xi Kang 2, Xiang-Xiang Xue 3,6, Chengqun Yang 4, Lan Zhang 3, Shude Mao 5, Chao Liu 3
arxiv-2510-08684.description: Abstract Unveiling the 3D shape of the Milky Way’s dark-matter halo is critical to understanding its formation history. We created an innovative dynamical model with minimal assumptions on the internal dynamical structures and accommodates a highly flexible triaxial DM halo.

arxiv-2511-17582.title: GateRA: Token-Aware Modulation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Thanks: Corresponding author.
arxiv-2511-17582.description: Abstract Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, such as LoRA, DoRA, and HiRA, enable lightweight adaptation of large pre-trained models via low-rank updates. However, existing PEFT approaches apply static, input-agnostic updates to all tokens, disregarding the varying importance and difficulty of different inputs.

arxiv-2512-02907.title: Tunable giant Purcell enhancement of quantum light emitters by means of acoustic graphene plasmons
arxiv-2512-02907.creator: Justin Gruber, Mahtab A. Khan, Dirk R. Englund, Michael N. Leuenberger
arxiv-2512-02907.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Justin Gruber, Mahtab A. Khan, Dirk R. Englund, Michael N. Leuenberger. Inspired by the remarkable ability of plasmons to boost radiative emission rates, we propose leveraging acoustic graphene plasmons (AGPs) to realize tunable, giant Purcell enhancements for single-photon, entangled-photon, and multipolar quantum emitters.

arxiv-2512-24288.title: Real-world Reinforcement Learning from Suboptimal Interventions
arxiv-2512-24288.creator: Yinuo Zhao, Huiqian Jin, Lechun Jiang, Xinyi Zhang, Kun Wu, Pei Ren, Zhiyuan Xu, Zhengping Che, Lei Sun, Dapeng Wu, Chi Harold Liu, Jian Tang
arxiv-2512-24288.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yinuo Zhao, Huiqian Jin, Lechun Jiang, Xinyi Zhang, Kun Wu, Pei Ren, Zhiyuan Xu, Zhengping Che, Lei Sun, Dapeng Wu, Chi Harold Liu, Jian Tang. Real-world reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising approach to training precise and dexterous robotic manipulation policies in an online manner, enabling robots to learn from their own experience while gradually reducing human labor.

arxiv-2601-21756.title: The Classification of Supersingular Elliptic Curves in characteristic 3
arxiv-2601-21756.creator: Alexey Orlov
arxiv-2601-21756.description: Abstract . We provide an explicit classification of supersingular elliptic curves in characteristic 3 into isomorphism classes, and give explicit formulae for their point counts. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 11G20 11Y16 11T24 1. Canonical Form We fix q=3^{d} and consider an elliptic curve E/\mathbb{F}_{q}:y^{2}+a_{1}xy+a_{3}y=x^{3}+a_{2}x^{2}+a_{4}x+a_{6}. Completing the square via the substitution y\mapsto\frac{y-a_{1}x-a_{3}}{2}, we obtain y^{2}=4x^{3}+b_{2}x^{2}+2b_{4}x+b_{6}, where, as usual, \begin{split}b_{2}&=a_{1}^{2}+4a_{2},\\ b_{4}&=2a_{4}+a_{1}a_{3},\\ b_{6}&=a_{3}^{2}+4a_{6}.

britannica-1911-ribbeck-johann-carl-otto.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-ribbeck-johann-carl-otto.description: Article 'Ribbeck, Johann Carl Otto' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. classical scholar, was born at Erfurt in Saxony on the 23rd of July 1827. Having held professorial appointments at Kiel and Heidelberg, he succeeded his tutor Ritschl in the chair of classical philology at Leipzig, where he died on the 18th of July 1898.

pmc-10547749.title: Functional consequences of A-to-I editing of miR-379 in prostate cancer cells
pmc-10547749.creator: Gjendine Voss, James R Cassidy, Yvonne Ceder
pmc-10547749.description: Prostate cancer is the predominant cause of cancer in men, but there is still a lack of biomarkers and treatments for metastatic spread. The initial promise of microRNAs to provide avenues to solve these problems has been dampened by the realisation that microRNAs co-exist in multiple functionally distinct isoforms, for example due to A-to-I editing.

pmc-11497672.title: The MIND diet, brain transcriptomic alterations, and dementia
pmc-11497672.creator: Jun Li, Ana W Capuano, Puja Agarwal, Zoe Arvanitakis, Yanling Wang, Philip L De Jager, Julie A Schneider, Shinya Tasaki, Katia de Paiva Lopes, Frank B Hu, David A Bennett, Liming Liang, Francine Grodstein
pmc-11497672.description: INTRODUCTIONDietary patterns are associated with dementia risk, but the underlying molecular mechanisms are largely unknown.METHODSWe used RNA sequencing data from post mortem prefrontal cortex tissue and annual cognitive evaluations from 1204 participants in the Religious Orders Study and Memory and Aging Project.

pmc-11526176.title: DFT simulations of the elastic, optoelectronic, and thermoelectric attributes of AOsCl3 (A = K, Rb), a robust and environmentally friendly perovskites for green energy implications
pmc-11526176.creator: Danish Abdullah, Dinesh C. Gupta
pmc-11526176.description: Halide perovskites are an intriguing renewable energy materials that may assist in addressing the world’s energy scarcity. The Goldsmith tolerance factor (0.99 and 1.00) and negative formation energy guarantee the examined materials’ structural and thermodynamic stabilities. The Poisson’s and Pugh’s ratio proves the reviewed materials’ ductile nature. K/RbOsCl3 has electronic band gaps of 1.37 eV/1.

pmc-12576743.title: Spinal involvement in chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis - diagnostics, treatment and what remains in the shadows: A literature review
pmc-12576743.creator: Veronika V Petukhova, Alexey S Maletin, Alexander Yu Mushkin, Mikhail M Kostik
pmc-12576743.description: BACKGROUNDChronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis (CRMO) is a rare autoinflammatory bone disorder primarily affecting children and adolescents. Spinal involvement in CRMO is common and can lead to significant clinical features and complications, including severe chronic back pain and spinal deformities with possible spinal cord compression.

pmc-13276017.title: The Impact of DRG Review Teams on Obstetric Disease Management and Cost Control: A Variance Analysis Approach
pmc-13276017.creator: Xia Liang, Rui Zhang, Congling Liao, Yanxia Zhou
pmc-13276017.description: AimThe global transition toward Diagnosis‐Related Groups (DRG) payment systems has fundamentally reshaped hospital reimbursement landscapes, yet obstetric departments present distinctive implementation challenges owing to the dual‐patient paradigm and inherent clinical heterogeneity of maternal‐fetal medicine. This study investigates whether strategically constituted DRG review teams can optimize both cost containment and care quality in obstetric settings through variance analysis methodology.

pmc-13352698.creator: Jinshun You, Jiaqi Wu, Lingfang Zheng, Jingyi Pei, Shujie Xia, Shijie Qiao
pmc-13352698.description: ObjectiveThis study investigated the association between the Oxidative Balance Score (OBS) and the odds of depressive symptoms in adults with metabolic syndrome (MetS) using National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data (2007–2018), and employed machine learning to enhance predictive insights.MethodsWe analyzed 6,244 U.S. adults with MetS.

pmc-13671236.title: DeepU-PRS: nonlinear and uncertainty-aware SNP heritability modeling for annotation-informed polygenic risk scoring
pmc-13671236.creator: Junhyeong Lee, Dokyoon Kim, Seunggeun Lee
pmc-13671236.description: Polygenic risk scores (PRSs) are widely used to quantify genetic predisposition to complex traits, and their predictive accuracy can be enhanced by incorporating functional annotations into single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) effect-size estimation. Existing approaches typically assume linear relationships between annotations and SNP effects, neglecting predictive aleatoric variance and potential nonlinear regulatory interactions.

ACTION: Final rule. ----------------------------------------------------------------------- SUMMARY: This regulation establishes tolerances for residues of thiencarbazone-methyl [methyl 4-[[[(4,5-dihydro-3-methoxy-4-methyl-5- oxo-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)-carbonyl]amino]sulfonyl]-5-methyl-3- thiophenecarboxylate], per se.
